text: The earlier generous estimate needed 18 observable universes. The derived model needs about 12,000, landing inside the old declared bracket, but 25 times below its generous edge. The same chain also turns the microwave background limit around. Inherited parent spin must be diluted by more than 1022 for a supermassive parent, or 1030 for a stellar parent. That constraint is real, but weak. It rules out too little dilution, not parent spin itself.
